facts.text: He spills them all down his front.
facts.why: Albert's food mishap in the film is dropping mustard on his shirt, not spilling meatball sliders. The film also has a salad thrown on Sara after an argument.
facts.fix: He drips mustard down his front.

vibe.verdict: Uses the allergy, Ellis Island and Albert well, but the stock bistro layout makes it feel like any date night menu.
